result:
RESULT: DONE
CHANGED: web/app/teams/[team_id]/workflow/page.tsx, web/app/teams/[team_id]/workflow/WorkflowSettingsClient.tsx
TESTS: npx tsc --noEmit (from web/) -> no output, exit clean
NOTES:
- A 404 on either the workflow GET or the members GET calls notFound(). A null workflow body (no active workflow) shows an empty state.
- The remap form includes a required `map_key` input, because the backend `RemapBody` requires it. The acceptance text only listed `mappings`.
- A 422 shows field errors, derived from the `loc` and `msg` of each error. Any other failure shows a banner with `detail`. Both use `credentials: "include"` and `csrfHeaders`.
- Draft transitions with from_stage "any" are sent as null, and empty `signoff_roles` or `allowed_kinds` are sent as null.
- `tsc` is the only check I ran. I did not exercise the UI in a browser or test it against the backend.
